name: voice-profile
description: Measure your writing voice from your own pre-AI writing and calls, score your Big Five with quoted evidence, and get a prompt plus a pass/fail verifier that holds AI to your voice.

interface.longDescription: Voice Profile measures how you write from your own pre-AI writing. It scores ten features of your prose, finds your writing modes, scores your Big Five traits with quotes from your own words, and builds a prompt that makes AI write the way you do. A verifier then scores any draft against your profile and returns pass or fail per feature, so 'does this sound like me' stops being a vibe. In ChatGPT, a stateless measurement service runs the numbers and stores nothing. You can also compare your style with 37 public-domain authors, feature by feature.
